items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: I had forgotten all about him. His daddy was nice towards our band.

ctx.x: Yes, I did know him. Did he ever play with you? Yes, often. Used to come around and play on our job like that. He was a very nice style band.
Harry Sushant told me he took lessons from Chinese, I didn't know that. What did he tell me?
